Hand-written thesis overrides. scripts/build-theses.js merges these on top of its auto-extracted output. Use this for companies where pdftotext mangled the source or the auto-extracted sentence was clipped / metadata-y / verbatim-quoting-an-irrelevant-line. Each override can swap specific broker views (via _replaceHouseViews) or the whole bull/bear paragraph block. Paragraphs are split by \n\n in the output strings; each becomes its own

in the renderer. Citation marker syntax: [CITE:Broker|YYMMDD|encodeURIComponent(url)|page].

houseViews.paragraph: Kotak reads the **FY26 annual report** as proof that ADSEZ's investment cycle has stepped up: standalone investments and loans-and-advances ran at roughly **3x the FY20-25 annual pace**, funded largely from operating cash flow rather than incremental debt. They view the balance-sheet-led capex as the key set-up for the next leg of cargo-volume and EBITDA growth, and reiterate **ADD with a Fair Value of ₹1,900**.

Adani Ports and SEZ.bullParagraph:
Jefferies sees ADSEZ's **1bn-tonne cargo target by 2030** (16% CAGR vs Jefferies' own 13% baseline) as broadly achievable, with **organic growth in domestic ports** and existing international capacity doing most of the heavy lifting before incremental brownfield expansion at Mundra, Vizhinjam and Hazira kicks in. [CITE:Jeff|260604|file%3A%2F%2F%2FC%3A%2FUsers%2Fadmin%2FDesktop%2FIndia%2520Related%2520Reports%2FAdani%2520Ports%2520and%2520SEZ%2F%255B260604%255D%2520%255BJefferies%255D%2520Adani%2520Ports%2520and%2520SEZ%2520-%2520Management%2520Meet%2520Takeaways.pdf|1]

Kotak reads the **FY26 annual report** as proof that the investment cycle has stepped up — standalone investments and loans-and-advances ran at roughly **3x the FY20-25 annual pace**, funded largely from internal accruals rather than incremental debt. They see this balance-sheet-led capex as the set-up for the next leg of cargo-volume and EBITDA growth and reiterate **ADD with a Fair Value of ₹1,900**. [CITE:Kotak|260603|file%3A%2F%2F%2FC%3A%2FUsers%2Fadmin%2FDesktop%2FIndia%2520Related%2520Reports%2FAdani%2520Ports%2520and%2520SEZ%2F%255B260603%255D%2520%255BKotak%255D%2520Adani%2520Ports%2520and%2520SEZ%2520-%2520AR2026%252C%2520Investment%2520engine%2520starting%2520to%2520show%2520its%2520colors.pdf|1]

Nomura flags the **May-26 cargo traffic print of 48mt (+16% y/y, +12% m/m)** — the eighth straight month of double-digit growth — driven by container and liquid cargo, and reads this as evidence that the long-term **6-8% structural traffic CAGR** assumption is intact heading into FY27.
